requirements.description: User wants the building located near green spaces. Value set at the 75th percentile (74.26, rounded to 74) because 'near' expresses a strong proximity need.
Preferred energy class D or better, so any class from A1 to D is accepted.
The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct minimum surface threshold.

output.explanation: Filters school-type properties (property_type = 'Attività scolastiche') with surface_area >= 600, within 3.0 km of the given coordinates, energy class A1–D, and green score >= 74. Results are ordered by haversine distance to the center point, nearest first. The 45-person capacity requirement is not in the extracted requirements, so it is not applied.
